map.出雏日 = 入孵日 + 21 天（鸡胚标准孵化期）。: Hatch date = set date + 21 days (the standard incubation period for chicken embryos).
map.孵化后期将种蛋从孵化盘移到出雏盘，便于雏鸡破壳活动并隔离绒毛。落盘后停止翻蛋、提: In the late stage move the eggs from the setter to the hatcher so the chicks can move about when hatching and to isolate down. After transfer, stop turning and raise the humidity.
map.用于孵化场生产排程与出雏计划。: Used for hatchery production scheduling and hatch planning.
map.落盘是什么意思？: What does moving to the hatcher mean?
map.落盘（移盘）约在第 18~19 天，照蛋在第 7、14 天。: Moving to the hatcher happens around day 18-19, and candling on days 7 and 14.
map.设置入孵日期，查看21天逐日胚胎发育、当前所处阶段、温湿度与照蛋提醒。: Set the set date to see 21 days of daily embryo development, the current stage, temperature and humidity and candling reminders.
map.鸡约 21 天，鸭 28、鹅 31 天不同。同一物种也受孵化温度影响，偏高略短、: Chickens take about 21 days, while ducks take 28 and geese 31. Even within a species the incubation temperature matters: a little higher shortens it and a little lower lengthens it. Follow the species standard and confirm by candling.
map.鸡蛋孵化倒计时（21天） 使用指南: Egg Incubation Countdown (21 Days) User Guide
map.：3 月 1 日 9:00 入孵，标准为 21 天，出雏日 ≈ 3 月 22 日: : incubation starts March 1 at 9:00 with a 21-day standard, so the hatch date is about March 22. Transfer to the hatcher on day 18 (3/19); first candling on day 7 (3/8) removes infertile eggs and the second on day 14 (3/15) removes dead embryos.
